Container.Name: fluent-bit-syslog-adx
Container.Overview: Fluent Bit syslog forwarder configured with Lua parsing and native Azure Data Explorer (ADX) ingestion. Listens for both UDP and TCP syslog traffic.
Container.Requires:
Before deploying, ensure you have completed the following prerequisites:
1. Azure Entra ID & ADX Setup: Configure your Service Principal, ADX cluster, target database, Syslog table, JSON mapping, and 30-day retention policy (recommended for Free Tier). Grant the Service Principal 'ingestors' role permissions. 2. Configuration Files: Manually copy 'fluent-bit.yaml' and 'syslog-to-la.lua' into your appdata folder (/mnt/user/appdata/fluent-bit) before launching the container for the first time.
Sample files and step-by-step guidance are available in the GitHub repository: https://github.com/DataBitz/unraid-fluent-bit-syslog-adx/blob/main/README.md
Container.Description: Fluent Bit syslog forwarder (UDP/TCP) with Lua transformation and native Azure Data Explorer (ADX) ingestion.

Config.Name: Config Directory
Config.Description: The host path where fluent-bit.yaml and syslog-to-la.lua must be manually placed prior to container startup.

Config.Name: Syslog Port (UDP & TCP)
Config.Description: Listening UDP and TCP port bound directly to the host network interface in host mode.

Config.Name: Azure Tenant ID
Config.Description: Your Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) Directory / Tenant ID.

Config.Name: Azure Client ID
Config.Description: The Application (Client) ID for the Service Principal/App Registration used to authenticate to Azure Data Explorer.

Config.Name: Azure Client Secret
Config.Description: The Client Secret value generated for your Service Principal.

Config.Name: ADX Data Ingestion URI
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Enter your cluster's ADX Data Ingestion Endpoint URI (e.g. https://ingest-yourcluster.region.kusto.windows.net).

Config.Name: ADX Database Name
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Enter the name of your target database inside your ADX cluster where logs will be stored (e.g. MyDatabase).

Config.Name: ADX Table Name
Config.Description: The name of the ADX table created to hold syslog entries.

Config.Name: ADX Mapping Name
Config.Description: The name of the JSON ingestion mapping created on your ADX table.
